net.idn_to_utf8.doc: idn_to_utf8($domain, $flags, INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_UTS46, $info): the Unicode name or false, and $info

quirks.description: IDNA_DEFAULT is nontransitional both ways (48) since PHP 8.4, while ICU's own default (0) is transitional: faß.de becomes xn--fa-hia.de with the default flags and fass.de with flags 0
Without IDNA_USE_STD3_RULES any ASCII is valid in a label, spaces and NUL included (UTS #46 since Unicode 15.1)
With flags 0 idn_to_utf8() maps deviation characters too (ß.de becomes ss.de)
Octets with leading zeros are rejected (the C library's inet_pton())
